reasoning: The icon consists solely of the three letters 'ODS' inside a rectangular border, representing a specific file extension (OpenDocument Spreadsheet). Because it is purely a text label rather than a pictorial symbol and becomes illegible or indistinguishable from other file-type badges at small sizes, a visual spreadsheet/table icon is always better.
